svg.title: Gearbox — tin toy robot
svg.desc: A coral 1950s tin toy robot with a square head, antenna knob and two round eyes, a big chest window of meshing yellow gears over a row of dials and lights, ring jointed arms with three finger hands, and sturdy legs on wide flat feet.
